name: neraca_psak109
query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT k.code AS code, k.nama AS nama,
         kl.noklasifikasi AS klno, kl.namaklasifikasi AS klnama,
         sk.nosubklasifikasi AS skno, sk.namasubklasifikasi AS sknama,
         G1.debit AS debit, G1.kredit AS kredit
  FROM (
    SELECT g.id AS gid, g.tanggal::date AS d, g.department_id AS department_id,
           g.project_id AS project_id, jv.account_id AS account_id,
           jv.cost_code_id AS cost_code_id, jv.debit AS debit, jv.kredit AS kredit
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  JOIN kiraan  k  ON k.id  = G1.account_id
  JOIN subklas sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas    kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
  WHERE kl.noklasifikasi IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9) {andWhere}
)
SELECT kelompok_urut, kelompok, subkelompok_urut, subkelompok, akun_kode, akun_nama, nilai
FROM (
  -- Akun-akun NERACA (Aset / Liabilitas / Dana). Surplus L/R digabungkan ke
  -- akun laba tahun berjalan: 3201010100001 (Aset Neto Ifsho Umum).
  SELECT
    klno AS kelompok_urut,
    CASE WHEN klno = 3 THEN 'Dana' ELSE klnama END AS kelompok,
    skno AS subkelompok_urut, sknama AS subkelompok,
    code AS akun_kode, nama AS akun_nama,
    ((CASE WHEN klno = 1 THEN SUM(debit - kredit) ELSE SUM(kredit - debit) END)
      + CASE WHEN code = '3201010100001'
             THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kredit - debit),0) FROM base WHERE klno IN (4,5,6,7,8,9))
             ELSE 0 END
    )::numeric(18,2) AS nilai
  FROM base
  WHERE klno IN (1,2,3)
  GROUP BY klno, klnama, skno, sknama, code, nama
  HAVING SUM(debit - kredit) <> 0 OR code = '3201010100001'
) z
ORDER BY kelompok_urut, subkelompok_urut, akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}

    FROM g_jurnal g

    WHERE g.status = 'approved'

  JOIN kiraan  k  ON k.id  = G1.account_id

  JOIN klas    kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT 1 FROM base WHERE klno IN (1,2,3)

) q
